scheduler.rng: Dedicated RNG from run seed plus fixed salt99002; never consume level1 or unrelated RNG. Same runseed+same hero path gives same placements.
scheduler.type_bag: Fisher-Yates shuffle of all nine IDs. Peek the exact cohort types before planning size-aware positions. Consume entries only when the complete cohort actually spawns. Failed candidate search cannot discard or replace a type. Refill after all nine are consumed; retry resets dedicated seed, bag and wave state.
scheduler.occupancy: Exact scheduled simultaneous falling cohort, now up to seven. Floating objects do not consume falling slots and may not be silently deleted to satisfy any cap.
scheduler.wave_boundary: At each exact wave boundary, resolve the previous cohort landing before spawning the next cohort. Falling occupancy must equal the scheduled count and never exceed seven; persistent water floats do not count as falling objects.
scheduler.late_frame: Use fixed/substepped simulation or swepttime processing; do not skip elapsed cohorts or silently discard spawns on cap. No framebased RNG.
scheduler.phase_end: At35 disable damage and clearwarning/projectiletokens before finalimpact. Preserve lastcohort visiblylanding asharmless floatingprops, allfloatsdrainunderwatercurrent during35..43. No silentvisualdeletion.

fall.height_screen_pixels: For each prop, min(220, impact_screen_y - (64 + actual rendered upper extent above its anchor +8)). Use Art anchor-aware bounds; conservative full64px hamster extent requires initial foot y>=136. Keep wave duration unchanged across sizes.
fall.impact_ring: Fixed announced predicted landing center from commitment. Project each prop-specific hero-expanded radius (ordinary36, hamster54) into its warning ellipse. Never retarget or resize after warning.
fall.dynamic_shadow: Shadow at same fixed plane anchor as impact ring; scale/opacity increases continuously during descent and matches impact.
fall.trajectory: Vertical fall at fixed announced world-plane anchor. No airborne planar advection or hero tracking. Water floating starts only after impact.
fall.landing: Begin persistent floating collision and same water flow immediately at impact, except final t35 impact which is harmless.
fall.weapon_policy: No weapons or firing during the flush, per Sean. Every prop is avoided through swimming/dodging; no breakable or soft-shooting behavior.

floating.damage: All floating props are damaging throughout active gameplay until swallowed or t35. No expiry of danger after impact; no harmless decorative leftovers during active phase.
floating.movement: Use identical progressive inward/swirl field as water; deterministic per simulation tick, never track hero.
floating.capture_rule: Retire only when the entire contact disk fits within physical drain radius65: center<=65-prop_radius (ordinary43, hamster25). Align visible swallowing with removal. At35 disable damage while retaining visuals until swallowed. Never use a cap or lifetime to delete a dangerous float.
floating.collision: Swept hero/float relative motion; at most one damage for simultaneous overlaps, no per-object stacked burst.
floating.transition: At35 disable all damage and manual control in the same state change. Keep floats visible as harmless objects spiraling into drain; no earlier immunity/control fade.

pattern.reserved_rule: Reserve the chosen pocket slot and two neighbors on each side. Assign the already-peeked mixed-size cohort to the other seven slots with seeded permutation. All nine types share the bag.
pattern.radius_at_commit: For each assigned prop: clamp(hero_world_radius, inner(impact_time)+prop_radius, outer(impact_time)-prop_radius). Ordinary radius22; hamster40.
pattern.locking: Sample impact radius/positions only at cohort commitment, before any visible warning. Lock rings/landing points throughout descent. Use future bounds at impact so shrinking region cannot invalidate an announced landing.
pattern.pocket: A time-varying path within future annulus, not one static disk. Use midpoint radius and48-world safe disk as candidate, then validate actual swept paths.
pattern.safety: Simulate all existing persistent floats, all announced future impacts and shrinking bounds through candidate cohort landing and escape. Use actual current and minimum net steering130/110/90. Preserve reachable continuation into next cohort; a safe endpoint or five reserved slots alone is insufficient. Use each existing and future prop radius, including hamster54 hero-expanded and102 pocket clearance. Never plan as ordinary22 and assign large art afterward.
pattern.no_drop: Relocate entire new pattern before warning until safe; never lower count, consume a type without spawning, erase old dangerous floats or backlog past35. If no full-count safe pattern exists, treat as validation failure and revise layout before release.
pattern.combined_collision_radius_world: hero14 + each prop radius: ordinary36, hamster54
pattern.mixed_size_spacing: Require pairwise impact-center separation>=sum of prop radii. A cohort may contain two hamsters across a bag boundary; place them at least two30-degree slots apart when their radial positions would overlap at neighboring slots. Reassign slots before warning, without dropping or substituting types.

recovery_admission.authorization: Engineering explicitly approved this distinction after baseline-confirmed prior-warning contact at11.6s in idle Hard seed0.
recovery_admission.primary: Require strict zero-contact continuation for all extant and incoming hazards through35; no immunity or inherited-ID exemption.
recovery_admission.eligibility: If strict search fails, confirm old-only contact during the common eligible continuation prefix or unchanged-input reaction. A new-cohort-created trap is not eligible.
recovery_admission.verification: Simulate actual current shared immunity and one-point hits for every old and new float continuously. Compare candidate against best verified old-only continuation and paired old-only replay using candidate controls. Candidate future hit count must exceed neither baseline.
recovery_admission.record: admission=recovery, starting_immunity, baseline_hits, paired_baseline_hits, projected_hits, witness_start/end and commands. Never label recovery a zero-damage proof.
recovery_admission.failure: If neither strict nor baseline-bounded recovery succeeds, block and report validation failure without consuming types or silently dropping the cohort. Death ends an attempt legitimately.
recovery_admission.comparison: Among evaluated old-only routes use minimum verified damage. Incoming contact must be zero against exact chosen route, so paired old-only and combined damage are identical by construction. Recovery is not a survival guarantee beyond a lethal old hit; runtime death ends the attempt.

reaction_continuation.behavior: Use those next18 commands as candidate reaction prefix for all strict, old-only, recovery and paired proofs. Resimulate actual position and every collision; never override live player input. Otherwise hold prior input for0.15s.
reaction_continuation.provenance: Ledger stores witness positions, mode, hero_speed, used_continuation and reaction_source. Reset clears eligibility.

Try other placements before another old route. Eligible full prior witness may be resimulated first. No physical feedback from props to hero/current is assumed.

Do not pad passive zero-input drift: future placements must reward active escape. Full prior route reuse originates from this active route.
